subject: gk
question: What is the name of the first Indian tribal president?
solution:
The correct answer is __Droupadi Murmu.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Former Jharkhand Governor and National Democratic Alliance candidate Droupadi Murmu were elected the 15th President of India on 21 July 2022.
 
• She is the first tribal woman to be elected to the position & the youngest as well. 
 
• She defeated opposition candidate Yashwant Sinha by bagging 64.03% of the electoral college votes.
 
• She will take oath on 25 July 2022 and will replace Ram Nath Kovind.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Bishweswar Tudu is a prominent tribal leader from West Bengal who served as a Member of Parliament from 1998 to 2009.
 
• Jasvantsinh Bhabhor is a tribal leader from Gujarat who served as the Minister of State for Tribal Affairs in the Government of India from 2014 to 2019.
 
• Sudarshan Bhagat is a politician from Jharkhand who served as the Minister of State for Tribal Affairs in the Government of India from 2014 to 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
